title: Attio hero
description: A centred product hero on white: a rounded news pill with a short blue light running along its top edge, a big tightly tracked headline, a grey line and outline + near-black buttons (an email field and full-width button on phones), then a wide grey-bezelled app window on a lavender pinstriped wash. Everything rises in on load; on scroll the text stays pinned and fades and blurs away as the window slides over it and settles 5% smaller.
notes: the window is a media slot (1080×580 inside its bezel); empty, it is a white placeholder
scroll effects use the page's scroll position, so it belongs at the top of a page; CSS only
the pinned text sits under a 100px (phones) / 116px (desktop) header
